items.title: 19.1.3 The Concept of Genes and Alleles (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of genes and alleles (PDF 118-119).

blocks.text: 1909 mein Danish mahir-e-nabatat Wilhelm Johannsen ne virasat ki bunyadi ikai ke liye lafz 'gene' rakha. Baad mein pata chala ke gene 'DNA ka chhota hissa hai jo kisi khaas polypeptide ke amino acids ki tarteeb ka code deta hai'. Chromosome ka saara DNA amino acids ki tarteeb ka paigham nahi rakhta; is ke chhote hisse, yaani genes, proteins ka code dete hain. Chromosome par gene ki jagah us ka locus (jama loci) hai.

Homologous chromosomes par gene ki mutabadil shaklein, yaani alleles, aik hi locus par hoti hain. Agar aik chromosome par kisi khaas locus par aankh ke rang ka allele ho to us ka homologue usi locus par usi khasiyat ka allele rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: homologous chromosomes ka jora; aik par alleles G, R, S, T aur doosre par unhi chaar loci par g, r, s, t. T aur t ke gird tooti lakeer ka dabba 'Alleles of a gene at same locus'. 'Duplication of chromatids' wala teer duplicate jore tak: ab har chromosome ke do sister chromatids hain jin par aik jaise alleles hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.5: Homologous chromosomes par alleles (kitab ki Figure 19.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Homologous chromosomes, Alleles of a gene at same locus, Duplication of chromatids, Sister chromatids (with identical alleles).

blocks.prompt: Locus kya hai, aur gene ke do alleles kahan milte hain?
blocks.explanation: Locus chromosome par gene ki muqarrar jagah hai. Do alleles do homologous chromosomes par aik hi locus par hote hain.

items: Johannsen (1909) ne gene ka naam rakha.
Gene: aik polypeptide ka code dene wala DNA hissa; locus: us ki jagah.
Gene ke alleles homologues par aik hi locus par.
